contract: regression trials from incidents — docs/CONTRACTS.md section 60
_comment: `gnomon improve --incidents` drafts a trial spec per kind of incident found in the verified audit trails, as a `harness` proposal for trials/incident-<stem>-<hash8>.toml.
A trial spec is the judge a change is measured by, so only a person accepts one: [improve] auto_accept never covers a proposal that touches trials/, and the agent never proposes one.
packages/gnomon-core/src/incident_trials.test.ts asserts this file against the code.

proposal.evidence: trail and seq of the first records of the incident, at most 5

signals.guard_hold: a tool_call record with bucket refusal and governance.decision deny, or a guard record with decision deny; keyed by the rule
signals.verify_recovered: a verify record with ok false followed, in the same trail, by one with ok true for the same declared command
signals.overflow_recovered: a turn record with counters.model_calls.trims.overflow > 0 and a stop_reason other than endpoint_error

skipped: a guard rule with no probe (for example secret_path), a declared command with characters a check line should not repeat, a draft already in the surface or already pending, and any beyond the cap
trails: only a trail whose hash chain verifies is read; a broken one is named in notes and left out
copies: nothing from a record but the incident's kind, its rule name and a declared [verify] command: no path, no command line, no prompt, no file content

refusals.policy_accept: a trial spec is the judge a change is measured by, so only a person accepts one
refusals.agent_propose: the agent does not propose one

spec: [trial] attempts 2, check_timeout_seconds 60; [budget] max_requests 40; one [[task]] with id, prompt, optional setup and a check; a comment head naming the incident kind, its evidence and what it does not check
